create_parser: create a CLI argument parser for diffusion model benchmarking with options for compile, quantization, and device selection
benchmark_fn: benchmark a callable function using torch.utils.benchmark.Timer and return the mean execution time in seconds
generate_csv_dict: generate a dictionary of benchmarking results from pipeline class name, parsed arguments, and measured inference time
write_to_csv: write a single benchmarking result dictionary to a CSV file with standardized field headers
collate_csv: collate multiple identically structured benchmarking CSV files into a single combined CSV output file
